genese.intro: Experience Grim’s legendary live unboxing. Before thousands of enthusiasts, François Poulat’s "PikaPoulat" canvas made a spectacular entrance on the stream. From the moment it was unwrapped to its final installation under the spotlight, this 50×50 cm contemporary piece took over the set, transforming the atmosphere of the setup forever.
genese.body: InRealArt orchestrated the secure shipment from François Poulat's studio to Grim's setup. Armored crate, insured transit, and a hand-signed certificate of authenticity waiting inside.

artist.title: The Pop Art Material of François Poulat
artist.body: Exhibited internationally, François Poulat stands out for his mastery of color contrasts and his poetic rearrangement of Pop Culture icons. His canvases combine graphic rigor with the raw energy of palette-knife painting.
artist.quote: "Reinventing Pop iconography for Grim's studio was a captivating challenge: infuse gaming energy and pop culture into a custom-made Dibond artwork designed for its world."

origin.question: Where are the artworks made?
origin.answer: All physical editions are 100% made and assembled in France. Every print is carefully framed, varnished, and inspected locally to guarantee the highest standard of French art craftsmanship.

payment.question: How does the 75% deposit payment work?
payment.answer: When you place your order, you pay a 75% deposit via our secure Stripe checkout to cover production costs and lock your place in the queue. The remaining 25% balance is requested once the piece passes final quality inspection and is ready to ship.

delivery.question: What are the production and delivery times?
delivery.answer: Since each artwork is individually prepared, hand-varnished, and mounted on its frame, please allow 2 to 3 weeks for production. Express delivery then takes 48 to 72 hours via specialized artwork carriers with real-time priority tracking.

packaging.question: How is the artwork packaged for transport?
packaging.answer: Each piece is wrapped in a moisture-protective film, encased in high-density protective foam, and shipped in a custom-engineered reinforced heavy-duty box designed to resist shocks and ensure safe transit.

certificate.question: Does the artwork come with a Certificate of Authenticity?
certificate.answer: Yes. Every physical artwork comes with its physical Certificate of Authenticity, sealed, numbered, and hand-signed by the artist François Poulat.

paymentMethods.question: Which payment methods do you accept?
paymentMethods.answer: We process all transactions securely through Stripe. You can pay using major credit and debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express) as well as Apple Pay and Google Pay.

damage.question: What happens if the artwork arrives damaged?
damage.answer: In the rare event of transit damage, notify us within 48 hours of delivery with photos of the package and the artwork. We will immediately arrange a priority collection and ship a replacement piece at no extra cost to you.

shipping.question: Do you ship internationally?
shipping.answer: Yes, we ship worldwide using fully insured, specialized art carriers. Shipping fees and estimated transit times are automatically calculated at checkout based on your delivery address.
